name: Hybrid two-level validation
final_decision: Blocking rules remain: QUESTIONABLE/UNSUPPORTED block production PASS. Unknown codes FAIL. Coverage FAIL is local and does not require the model to recount characters.
presegmentation_in_c: Relevant. Architecture C can consume B's units so the model never emits offsets.
advantages: Separates what code can guarantee from what only a model can judge.
Preserves observed true positives as model tasks.
Makes h11-style word-ending gaps locally impossible on new calls.
limits: Semantic false rejections remain untested under C.
Two-level design can still over-trust isolated units.
Migration requires a new contract and a later authorized Terra canary.
complexity: Highest local complexity; lowest model structural load.
cost: Hypothetical. Fewer output fields; unknown reasoning-token effect.
